versions.changelog:
- Initial release of japan-seasons skill.
- Provides endpoints for cherry blossom forecasts, autumn foliage tracking, and festival search in Japan.
- Users can query bloom dates, historical data, and travel recommendations for sakura and kouyou.
- Search for Japanese festivals by region, month, and category; view upcoming events and festival details.
- Requires a free API key from https://jpseasons.dokos.dev/dashboard.
